_doc: Photographs from Wikimedia Commons for the Reference section (tools/extractor/src/photos.mjs). Key: pic:<BMS picture name> (stands in for that picture everywhere: same type, variant and nation), or aircraft:/weapon:/enc:<key>, threat:<id> for one entry. Each file was checked by its title, description and categories and by eye to show exactly what the entry names; only public domain, CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA. focus = where the 320:151 band sits (0 top, 1 bottom), fx = across, zoom > 1 crops in.
